annotation.title_clean: 商务部等9部门关于促进航空保税维修高质量发展的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the Ministry of Commerce and Eight Other Departments on Promoting High-Quality Development of Aviation Bonded Maintenance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China (MOFCOM) and eight other departments
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt (item 12) from Chinese MOFCOM-led nine-department opinions on aviation bonded maintenance. It requires firms to run an ERP system networked with customs for traceability, sets conditions for domestic sale of goods under maintenance, and requires solid waste from maintenance to be managed under domestic rules. The text does not cover AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Firms doing aviation bonded maintenance must have an ERP system networked with customs, so material use can be traced end to end
Goods that qualify may be sold domestically once permits are checked, but goods whose import is banned or restricted may not
Solid waste from maintenance must be managed under domestic solid-waste rules
Responsibility is split among the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, MOFCOM, the General Administration of Customs and the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC)
